cases.name: filter-failed-create-recipient
cases.requirement: A failed top-level CREATE has no created-address match.

cases.name: filter-failed-nested-create-recipient
cases.requirement: A failed nested CREATE has no created-address match.

cases.name: filter-failed-create-creator
cases.requirement: A failed CREATE still matches its creator.

cases.name: filter-failed-nested-create-creator
cases.requirement: A failed nested CREATE matches its creating contract.

cases.name: filter-failed-create-union
cases.requirement: Union mode retains the creator match of a failed CREATE.

cases.name: filter-failed-create-intersection
cases.requirement: A failed CREATE has no recipient side, so an intersection with its would-be address is empty.

cases.name: filter-destroyed-recipient
cases.requirement: A created-then-destroyed address matches its creation and its SELFDESTRUCT beneficiary.

cases.name: filter-self-destruct-from
cases.requirement: A SELFDESTRUCT matches fromAddress by its executing account.

cases.name: filter-self-destruct-to
cases.requirement: A SELFDESTRUCT to self also matches toAddress as its own beneficiary.

description: Mined Prague probes: own-block system reads, failed and self-destructing creations, capped SSTORE refunds, folded EIP-7702 tuples and a blob fee. Expectations derive from the frozen chain and hand-counted gas.

assertions.requirement: The sender pays value, receipt gas at the effective price and any blob fee, and its nonce advances once.
The fee recipient gains exactly the priority fee on the receipt gas.
The creation and its SELFDESTRUCT both appear.
The factory call returns the created address word.
The creation succeeds with empty code before destroying itself.
The suicide frame transfers the new contract’s whole balance, including any prefunded wei, to itself.
A prefunded address destroyed in its creating transaction is a deletion: - markers for its pre-state and storage {}.
The factory forwards the value it received, so only its nonce changes.

The would-be address of a reverted CREATE is absent at both endpoints and has no account diff.
